schema: CREATE TABLE stock(item TEXT PRIMARY KEY,quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity>=0),unit_cost_cents INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE stock_events(seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,item TEXT,before_quantity INTEGER,after_quantity INTEGER)
CREATE TRIGGER stock_insert AFTER INSERT ON stock BEGIN INSERT INTO stock_events(item,before_quantity,after_quantity) VALUES(new.item,NULL,new.quantity);END
CREATE TRIGGER stock_update AFTER UPDATE ON stock BEGIN INSERT INTO stock_events(item,before_quantity,after_quantity) VALUES(new.item,old.quantity,new.quantity);END
